name: Supervisor / swarm
summary: LangChain's LangGraph offers two prebuilt multi-agent libraries: langgraph-supervisor, where a central agent routes work to specialists, and langgraph-swarm, where agents hand off control to each other and the last active agent is remembered. LangChain now recommends building the supervisor pattern directly with tools for most cases.
facts: Swarm needs a checkpointer to remember the active agent
watchOut: The supervisor library is no longer the recommended route; LangChain suggests tools instead
Both libraries are pre-1.0 with infrequent releases
